subject: 起飛與降落性能 - V-Speeds 與進場分類

mc_questions.zh_question: 根據影片內容,在全引擎(All-engine)運作情況下,起飛抬輪速度(Lift-off speed)與 Vmu 的關係為何?
zh_options: (A) 不得小於 1.05 倍的 Vmu
(B) 不得小於 1.1 倍的 Vmu
(D) 必須大於 1.2 倍的 Vmu
mc_questions.en_question: According to the video, what is the relationship between Lift-off speed and Vmu under all-engines operating conditions?
en_options: (A) Must not be less than 1.05 times Vmu
(B) Must not be less than 1.1 times Vmu
(D) Must be greater than 1.2 times Vmu
mc_questions.explanation: 影片中提到 All-engine operate 時,Lift-off speed 為 1.1 倍的 Vmu;而在 One engine inoperative 時則為 1.05 倍的 Vmu。

mc_questions.zh_question: 關於 V1 (Takeoff Action Speed) 的定義,下列敘述何者正確?
zh_options: (A) 飛機在跑道上能夠維持方向控制的最小速度
(B) 飛機達到安全爬升高度時的速度
(C) 飛行員必須採取第一個停止動作(如踩剎車或減油門)的最大速度
(D) 飛機可以安全離地並持續爬升的最小速度
mc_questions.en_question: Which of the following statements regarding the definition of V1 (Takeoff Action Speed) is correct?
en_options: (A) The minimum speed at which directional control can be maintained on the runway
(B) The speed at which the aircraft reaches a safe climb altitude
(C) The maximum speed at which the pilot must take the first action to stop the aircraft
(D) The minimum speed at which the aircraft can safely leave the ground and continue to climb
mc_questions.explanation: V1 是在起飛期間,若要決定中止起飛(Abort),飛行員必須採取第一個動作(如 apply brakes 或 reduce thrust)的最大速度,以確保在 Accelerate-Stop Distance 內停下。

mc_questions.zh_question: 在認證 Vmca (Minimum Control Speed in the Air) 時,對於航向變化(Heading Change)的限制為何?
mc_questions.en_question: During Vmca (Minimum Control Speed in the Air) certification, what is the limit for heading change?
mc_questions.explanation: 認證 Vmca 時有三個核心要求:Rudder pedal 不超過 150 磅、Bank angle 不超過 5 度,且 Heading change 不得超過 20 度。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Vmca 認證時,飛行員所需施加在方向舵踏板上的力道不得超過 {{c1::150}} 磅。
cloze_items.zh_translation: During Vmca certification, the force required on the rudder pedal must not exceed 150 lbs.
cloze_items.explanation: 這是法規對於單發失效時,飛行員體力負荷的限制基準。

cloze_items.cloze_text: 在 Vmca 認證測試中,允許的最大坡度(Bank Angle)為 {{c1::5}} 度。
cloze_items.zh_translation: In Vmca certification tests, the maximum allowable bank angle is 5 degrees.
cloze_items.explanation: 坡度可以輔助方向舵維持控制,但法規限制測試時不能超過此數值。

cloze_items.cloze_text: 飛機進場分類(Approach Category)是基於最大認證落地重量下,失速速度 Vso 的 {{c1::1.3}} 倍來計算。
cloze_items.zh_translation: The aircraft approach category is based on 1.3 times the stall speed (Vso) at the maximum certified landing weight.
cloze_items.explanation: 這是區分 Category A 到 E 的標準計算公式(或使用 Vref)。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Category A 飛機的進場速度定義為小於 {{c1::91}} 節(knots)。
cloze_items.zh_translation: Approach Category A is defined as having a speed of less than 91 knots.
cloze_items.explanation: 根據 Vso 或 Vref 計算出的速度分級,91 節是 Cat A 的上限。

cloze_items.cloze_text: V2 被定義為 {{c1::Takeoff Safety Speed}} (起飛安全速度)。
cloze_items.zh_translation: V2 is defined as the Takeoff Safety Speed.
cloze_items.explanation: V2 是確保飛機在單發失效後,仍能達到法規要求爬升梯度與高度的安全速度。
